proofLimits: Independent standard-library header/metadata/descriptors only; no application import, tokenizer/model execution, tensor-weight decoding or inference.
Full-file hashes read opaque input bytes, but no weight payload or non-allowlisted metadata value is retained. Tokenizer string values and metadata-region originals are excluded.
Numeric GGML encodings, including types unknown to Quantopsy, are observed without inferred byte lengths. Payload lengths, overlaps, decoding and model compatibility are not established.
This bounded little-endian version-3 observer refuses other versions/endianness, nested metadata arrays and declared limits; a refusal need not mean that the broader GGUF specification is invalid.

Before/after pathname, descriptor, root and full-file hash checks detect changes at their boundaries; they do not provide a filesystem snapshot. The supervisor owns process deadlines and artifact disposal.

Diagnostic completion is not per-file container admission, restoration-pair admission or recovered behavior.
No model/tokenizer code, inference, conversion, repair, provider account or closed authored-fixture check runs.
Only public pinned inputs are downloaded; original outputs contain bounded structural descriptors and metadata hashes, not weights/tokenizer arrays.
Signed redirect queries stay memory-only. Literal HTTPS host admission and public DNS checks are not a host-wide network attestation.
UID/PID/starttime/group and owned-root inventories qualify cleanup, not every host process. External/kernel termination can prevent verified cleanup.
